title: Extremal distributions of partially hyperbolic systems: the Lipschitz threshold
summary: We prove a sharp phase transition in the regularity of the extremal distribution $E^s \oplus E^u$ for $C^\infty$ volume-preserving partially hyperbolic diffeomorphisms on closed $3$-manifolds: if $E^s \oplus E^u$ is Lipschitz, then it is automatically $C^\infty$. This extends the rigidity phenomenon established by Foulon--Hasselblatt for conservative Anosov flows in dimension $3$ to the partially hyperbolic setting.
